title: DemultiplexStepConfig
description: Operator-pinned demultiplex knobs (actionConfig.demultiplex). Derived from workers/methyl_worker/demultiplex_runner.py. barcode_len defaults at runtime to len(barcode) when unset; that default is not a constant, so this schema leaves barcode_len without a default.

barcode_tsv.description: Barcode table path. Required at runtime unless skip is set. Alias: barcodeTsv. demultiplex_runner.py.

barcode_len.description: Bases to trim. When unset, runtime uses len(barcode). Alias: barcodeLen. demultiplex_runner.py.

skip.description: Skip demultiplex when true. demultiplex_runner.py / DemultiplexTaskInput.resolvedConfig description.
